about: The kinds of diagnostics of the toolkit: each with its number, RNL and four digits, and its short name, which are kept from one version to the next and never given to another kind; the severity and the message it is given with, as the code writes it; and the sections of the standard it is about. The thousands give the domain: 0 to 6 the domains of the standard, 7 the geometry hints, 8 the tools, 9 the kinds of the implementation of the domains 0 to 6 (9D00, D the domain). A kind of the versions 0.2 and 0.3 alone has no number.
